about_the_game:
Play QBob like you never have before in this modernized version of the 1996 shareware classic with updated graphics, music, sounds and gameplay!

Help QBob leap from rock to rock as he surveys an array of strangely shaped asteroids, all while avoiding a host of alien creatures—each more devious than the last. The job's not done until all the cubes have been marked for demolition. Hit the big red button and skedaddle to your escape rocket before the Big Kaboom!

QBob: Remastered is an action/arcade game, filled with strange space landscapes and bizarre, deadly alien creatures. Prepare to have your nerves jangled and your senses overloaded: the only sound you can hear is the beating of your own heart... that is, until you hear your helmet cracking!

Features:

  • 20 unique levels!

  • Three difficulty settings!

  • Customizable keyboard controls!

  • Mouse and gamepad support!

  • A groovin' soundtrack!

  • Colorful characters, art and environments!

  • Old school arcade intermissions!

  • Pop culture references that were dated even in 1996!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel or AMD), released after 2016
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Try the demo version first if you are unsure about compatability of your setup.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
  • Processor: Modern quad-core processor (from 2021 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Storage: 120 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
